Description: Governed object identity must remain traceable through all transformations.
Distinct frameworks must not be silently merged.
Mandatory dependencies must be satisfied before dependent transitions.
Access familiarity competency authorship and authority remain distinct.
Every governed transformation must remain reconstructable.
Uncertainty must remain explicit and must not be silently resolved.
Derived meaning must remain distinct from canonical meaning.
Actor action must remain within admitted role scope.
Canonical revision must trigger declared downstream review.
Semantic drift must be preserved and reconstructed.
Equivalent constitutional inputs must produce equivalent decisions.
Failure deferral refusal uncertainty suspension revocation and incompletion remain distinct.
No implementation or derived artifact may override the Constitution.
